record.angTrabahoAtSahodMo: Your work and pay, in one place.
record.nanditoPaRinAngRecord: Your record is still here, even without a household right now.
record.walaKangHouseholdNgayon: You don't have a household right now
record.hindiNagawaAngPdfSubukan: Couldn't make the PDF. Try again.
record.naipadalaMakikitaItoNgManager: Sent. Your manager will see it on their Pass.
record.hindiNabawiSubukanUlit: Couldn't take it back. Try again.
record.halUuwiNaAkoSa: e.g. I'm going home to the province
record.1NakapagbigayKaNaNg: 1. You've already given notice. Your employer can see it.
record.1MagbigayNgAbisoSa: 1. Give your employer notice: "Leaving? Give notice", above.
record.2TatapusinNilaAngEmployment: 2. They end your employment on your last day.
record.3BumalikDitoAtBurahin: 3. Come back here and delete your account.
record.kapagMayBagoKangEmployer: When you have a new employer, enter the invite code they give you. You'll see the terms before you join. Today, My week, Pantry and My pay open again once you join.
record.angRecordNaItinagoNg: The record each household kept. It doesn't change anymore.
record.itoAngRecordNgHousehold: This is the household's record of your work. They see the same numbers.
record.paraSaLoanVisaO: For a loan, a visa, or your next job. The PDF is on your phone, wherever you save it, even after you leave this household. Everything in it comes from the household's record in Linara.
record.sabihinSaHouseholdKungKailan: Tell the household when your last day is. It's better if they have a few days to prepare.
record.mayTrabahoKaPaKaya: You're still employed, so your account can't be deleted yet. Your employment has to end first, so your last pay and record are settled.
record.angPayslipsOrasAtLeave: Your payslips, hours and leave stay with the household you worked for for at least three years, because the law requires it. If you want a copy, download your record's PDF above first.
record.offlineSaved: No internet. This is your record as of {date}.
record.noticeGiven: Your last day: {date}. Your manager can see it. They end the employment, and your last pay is settled then.
record.deletionPending: On {date} you asked to delete your account. It will be done within {days} days. Until then, everything still works.
record.deletionWhat: Your login, your profile and your private notes will be deleted within {days} days. You can still take it back until then.
